sloka: ततो नील अम्बुद निभः प्रहस्तो नाम राक्षसः ।अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर् वाक्यम् शूरः सेना पतिस्तदा ॥६-८-१॥।।
transliteration: tato nīla ambuda nibhaḥ prahasto nāma rākṣasaḥ ।abravīt prāñjalir vākyam śūraḥ senā patistadā ॥6-8-1॥।।

translations.english: Then a Rakshasa whose body was like a dark cloud, called Prahastha, the heroic chief of the army, spoke these words with folded palms.
